notablePrerequisites:
Darksteel Plate attached to Apex Altisaur.
You have a way to deal damage to Apex Altisaur.
description:
Deal damage to Apex Altisaur, triggering its enrage ability, causing it to fight an opponent's creature with power one or greater.
Apex Altisaur is dealt damage by the creature, triggering its enrage ability, causing it to fight an opponent's creature with power one or greater.
Repeat step 2.
